info.title: Darpan GraphQL API
info.description: One endpoint for every query. The body carries a GraphQL query; the API key picks the tenant.

host.description: Your instance's backend host, not the app's host. The instance must allow https://developers.drpn.ai as a public API origin.

apiKey.description: Your `dgql_` API key. Your browser sends it straight to the host above; developers.drpn.ai never receives it. See [Authentication](/graphql/authentication).

query.description: A GraphQL query document. Queries only: a mutation is rejected.

variables.description: Values for the variables the query declares, e.g. `{"id": "F-20790"}`.

operationName.description: Which operation to run when the document names more than one.

data.description: The fields you asked for. Absent when the query was refused before it ran.

errors.description: Present when something failed. Each has a `message` and, where Darpan sets one, `extensions.code`; see [Errors](/graphql/errors).

extensions.description: `cost`: what the query cost and what is left in the key's bucket; see [Cost and throttling](/graphql/cost-and-throttling).

post.description: Runs one GraphQL query for the API key's tenant.

Check your key.summary: Check your key (works on any tenant)

auditReport.summary: auditReport: An audit's report for one morning, from the tenant of the API key.

auditFinding.summary: auditFinding: One finding by id, with its records, evidence, fix and history. Another tenant's finding reads as not found.

findings.summary: findings: The tenant's findings, oldest first by default; each node is the report's finding summary plus its audit, statement, category and period. ageDays is as of today in the tenant's time zone. Filter via `query:` search string. Allowed keys: audit, statement, category, state, period, firstFound

reconciliationResults.summary: reconciliationResults: Reconciliation run results, newest or oldest first. Filter via `query:` search string. Allowed keys: savedRunId, reconciliationRunId, ruleSetId, statusEnumId

200.description: Every response is HTTP 200, a refused one too: read `errors`.

refused.summary: A key that is unknown, disabled or expired
